h:
使用 ComfyUI 和 Lineart Controlnet 对漫画、草图或现有图像进行着色和重新着色

注意：

虽然它可以为漫画着色，但有时文本会变得乱七八糟，并且当您转到下一页时它缺乏一致性。

o.en:
Coloring and Recoloring Manga, Sketch or existing image with ComfyUI and Lineart Controlnet

Note:

Though it could color manga, the text some time turn into giberish and it lack consistency when you go to the next page.
